notes: Mirage looks reworked from the CEO's needs-work notes, each fix made once in the shared drawing so every look built on it changes too (runes/watch-faces.js, datetime-variants.js, row.js, kit.js, weather.js).
Radio (Date / Time) and Time's wide Arc drew nothing: the AM/PM helper called itself. Both draw again.

No serif anywhere ("i don't like this font it doesn't fit with anything"): Numerals and the three In words faces (Time, Date, Day of week) set in the portal's font, each word sized to stay inside its disk.
Halftone (Date / Time and Weather) is a true halftone: a staggered grid over the whole disk with no hard edge inside the circle, heavier toward the light, fading out before the rim.
Card and the Date card are drawn larger, all of them ("make all of this bigger").
